text: λαμβάνει ὁ Δεινόσαυρος τὰ νομίσματα καὶ εἰσφέρει εἰς τὸν σάκκον.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
five bright silver coins, flat and round with simple stamped designs, about the size of large buttons.
artist_notes: Keep the sack and coins prominent; show motion of coins dropping toward the sack.
positioning: Dinosaur stands at the bedside, front three-quarter view, holding the open sack in his left hand and reaching for the coins with his right, looking at them.
The small woven sack is held open at waist height toward the coins, mouth wide and ready to receive them.
The five bright silver coins hover just above the sack’s mouth as his fingers scoop them in.
